technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions present but lack bullish confirmation; price below all key moving averages with weak trend structure and negative accumulation signals make this a high-risk entry despite oversold bounce potential.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 29 days create a low-conviction setup with elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: Congressional activity is minimal and non-directional; broad market fear (36/100) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of news data and absence of senior/large-amount trades limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (229.4) indicates extreme market fear, and earnings in 29 days adds binary event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI 9, Stoch RSI, Williams %R) at support level (39.13) in fear-driven market create contrarian bounce potential with limited downside risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages with negative accumulation (CMF), weak trend structure (ADX), no bullish confirmation, earnings event risk in 29 days, and macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis) make this a low-conviction, high-risk setup despite oversold technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold technicals (RSI 9, Stoch RSI, Williams %R) at support create contrarian bounce potential in fear-driven market. However, lack of bullish confirmation, negative accumulation, and weak trend structure eliminate conviction despite price positioning.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings event in 29 days combined with inverted yield curve and VIX crisis (229.4) create binary downside risk that overshadows oversold bounce potential; price below all major moving averages signals structural weakness.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on low conviction; technical oversold vs. fundamental/macro weakness creates consensus bear case
